Subject: Your cheque bounce matter - CC/2684/2024

Dear Ms. Pillai,

Thank you for meeting us on 18 July 2025 about your dispute with Ravi Patel. As we understand it, the cheque was dishonoured because the signature did not match. The matter is listed before the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Ahmedabad.

Our advice is to obtain the bank's certificate on the signature mismatch and treat it as a dishonour under the cheque-bounce law. Please collect the bank's certificate on the signature mismatch and the drawer's earlier cheques and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of Rs 12,10,000.

Regards,
Adv. Tejas Oberoi
